operatingLessons.lesson: Assemble a reader-facing chapter from verified individual Studio scene files on a fresh main-based release branch; strip Studio headings/comments and validate continuity before PR. A successful branch write does not imply PR, CI, merge or deployment.

operatingLessons.lesson: Recheck PR mergeability after upstream merges; GitHub's initial mergeability result can be transient. When an earlier PR creation was rejected, a materially advanced branch may later support an authorized PR without bypassing checks.

operatingLessons.lesson: When researching early-sixteenth-century Sulu or Mindanao, separate period-specific evidence from later eighteenth–nineteenth-century raiding institutions; never transfer later vessel types, captive labor systems or the label 'pirate' into the novel without dated support.
